function.name: SET_CENTER
function.param: Number of grpah inside of library
New value to horizontal coordinate of the center
New value to vertical coordinate of the center
function.abstract: It allows to change the center of a graph

description.p:
This function allows to change the center of a graph. The center is a point within of the pixels of the graph that is used to:
Specify the meaning of the coordinate (x, y) when the graph is shown in screen. If a graph is shown in the coordinate (10, 15) it means that his center is drawn in that point.
Specify the point from as the graph is rotated. The center is not displaced, and the rest of graph turn to his round. View the variable .
Specify the point from as the operations of horizontal and vertical mirror are made. View the variable .
When a graph is used like pointer of the mouse, using the variable MOUSE.GRAPH, indicates the "hot" point of the same one, which is used to check where the mouse is marking.
When a graph has not assinged center (for example, because it has been recovered from a standard file like can be a PNG), it is used so like his geometric center.

This function allows to change that center, specifying a new coordinates for the same one. This coordinates are always in pixels inside of the graph, where the pixel (0, 0) represents the top left corner of the grpah and the coordinates increase towards down and right.
